decision: The competitor (Alfa Romeo Racing ORLEN) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Date 31 July 2021 Time 13:52 2021 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 29 July - 1 August 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 20) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (a) of the 2019 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of Car 99 (Antonio Giovinazzi) and team representative. Car 99 left its garage when car 18 was driving in the fast lane. As a result, the two cars had contact and the front wing of car 99 was damaged. The team of car 99 admitted that it was their fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 99 Unsafe Release
